Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You watch the creature set its feet and draw breath, matching the motion to an attack you have studied.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 6 squares that has already used an attack you witnessed this scene.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Choose that attack. The DA tells you which attribute defends against it and its range. You may share this observation aloud. This reveals no hidden attacks, resistances or other statistics and grants no Boon.
